name: FFS_DWH_EXPORT_FILE_RESULT
description: Stores history of Daily Extract runs for particular files.

columns.name: FILE_ID
columns.description: Export file identifier. Reference to DWH Export File table.

columns.name: EXTRACT_TYPE
columns.description: Purpose Of Extraction: Dwh, Bics, Dbaas, Oac.

columns.name: TIME
columns.description: Indicates date and time of extraction completion.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the extraction. Possible values: In progress, Completed, Failed.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file a data is extracted to.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ROWS
columns.description: Amount of updated entities in the file.

columns.name: FAILED_ROWS
columns.description: Amount of failed entities in the file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
